external_entities.name: developer
external_entities.description: A developer who pushes branches to the self-hosted git server and may manually trigger a rebuild of main.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
external_entities.notes: Any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand; that path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.

external_entities.name: public package registry
external_entities.description: The public package registry reached during dependency resolution.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

processes.name: build runner
processes.description: Picks up merges, fetches source, resolves the dependency lockfile, produces container images, publishes them to the image registry, calls the deploy controller, and can be used to manually rebuild main.
processes.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source, resolves the dependency lockfile and produces a container image.
processes.notes: The runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads. Any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand; that path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.

processes.name: deploy controller
processes.description: Maintains the record of which image SHA the estate should be running and receives release requests from the build runner.
processes.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network and holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on.

processes.name: store server
processes.description: A small server in each store's back office that checks the current release, pulls a differing image, and restarts the container.
processes.source_excerpt: Each store has a small server in the back office running the till software as a container.

processes.name: till software
processes.description: Software running as a container on each store server.
processes.source_excerpt: running the till software as a container

data_stores.name: self-hosted git server
data_stores.description: The self-hosted git server where developers push branches and from which the build runner fetches source.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server, which sits on the corporate network.

data_stores.name: image registry
data_stores.description: The registry where the build runner stores finished container images tagged with commit SHA and from which store servers pull images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry, which is also in the build environment.
data_stores.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it. Nobody has documented whether the image registry encrypts what it stores.

data_flows.name: push branches
data_flows.description: A developer pushes branches to the self-hosted git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

data_flows.name: fetch source
data_flows.description: The build runner fetches source from the self-hosted git server after a merge to main starts a build.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source

data_flows.name: publish image
data_flows.description: The build runner pushes the finished container image to the image registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry
data_flows.notes: Images are tagged with the commit sha.
data_flows.data_description: Finished container image tagged with the commit SHA

data_flows.name: set release
data_flows.description: The build runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make an image the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When the image is pushed the runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make that image the current release.
data_flows.notes: The runner uses a shared build token that is the same for every pipeline and has not been rotated since the pipeline was set up.

data_flows.name: check release
data_flows.description: Each store server asks the deploy controller what the current release is once a minute.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what a store server presents to the controller.

data_flows.name: pull image
data_flows.description: A store server pulls the image from the image registry when the current release differs from the image it is running.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it pulls that image from the registry and restarts the container
data_flows.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.
data_flows.data_description: Container image for the current release

data_flows.name: resolve dependencies
data_flows.description: The build runner reaches out to the public package registry while resolving the dependency lockfile.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet
data_flows.notes: The lockfile is taken as given, and the runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.

data_flows.name: trigger rebuild
data_flows.description: A developer logs in to the build runner and manually kicks off a rebuild of main.
data_flows.source_excerpt: any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand
data_flows.notes: This path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.
